name: Question 2
problem: A particle moves along a straight line relative to a fixed origin $O$ with acceleration, measured in $\text{m}/{\text{s}}^{2},$ given by the function $a(t)=\frac{1}{2}\operatorname{cos}⁡(2t)$, where $t$ is the time in seconds. Given that it is at rest when $t=0\,\text{s}$, find the velocity (in $\text{m/s}$)  of the particle at time $t.$

Question 2
?

A particle moves along a straight line relative to a fixed origin O with acceleration, measured in m/s2, given by the function a(t)=12cos⁡(2t), where t is the time in seconds. Given that it is at rest when t=0s, find the velocity (in m/s) of the particle at time t.

a
v(t)=12cos⁡(2t)
b
v(t)=14sin⁡(2t)
c
v(t)=12sin⁡(2t)
d
v(t)=14(cos⁡(2t)−1)
e
v(t)=14(sin⁡(2t)−1)
Submit
